{{Quote|Oh, dear me.|C-9PO|<ref name="NJO" />}}
'''C-9PO''' was a [[9PO-series protocol droid]] with [[Color/Legends|tinged red]] plating that wandered across the streets of [[Redhaven]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]].<ref name="NJO" /> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="Essential Reader's Companion" /> C-9PO observed the [[Red Knights of Life]], followers of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] agent [[Nom Anor]] whom he was [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|inciting]] to destroy all machines. The Knights realized that the [[Protocol droid/Legends|droid]] was watching and brought it to Redhaven's [[Square of Hopeful Redemption]] despite his attempt to escape. There, the followers [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] by throwing him from a great height into a pile of metal. While being destroyed, the droid felt glad that his [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] did not make him feel pain.<ref name="NJO" />

==Behind the scenes==
C-9PO appeared in the [[1999]] novel [[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime|''Vector Prime'']], written by [[R. A. Salvatore]] as the first volume in the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' novel series.<ref name="NJO" /> The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' erroneously states that C-9PO was stoned to death.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|103|C-9PO (See-Ninepio)}}</ref>
